name: 80031 · Westminster, CO
findings: ZIP 80031 (Westminster) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80031 (Westminster) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
